body: Laura Kazimer established Divine Emergence, LLC after years of hands-on experience. She has trained dozens of facilitators as a Master Trainer with Awakened Breath, conducted hundreds of private sessions, and led sold-out workshops and international retreats.

The training emphasizes trauma-informed breathwork supported by modern science. Intentional breathing has been shown to help process stress and emotion, trauma, anxiety, depression, addictive patterns, OCD, and so much more. It is for corporate professionals seeking meaningful careers, empaths called to service, therapists, yoga instructors, coaches, and anyone drawn to teach breathwork transformation.

title: Breathwork Training Program

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Introduction to Breathwork
steps.text: History and techniques across cultures, including Pranayama, Wim Hof, and Holotropic breathing. Learn how to teach nervous system regulation breathwork.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: The Autonomic Nervous System
steps.text: Dive deep into the nervous system, autonomic nervous system, and brain patterns. Learn how to teach functional breathwork.

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Altered States of Consciousness
steps.text: Deep breathwork journeys and conscious circular breathing.

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: Trauma Awareness
steps.text: Trauma awareness is understanding how past experiences can influence the nervous system, behavior, and a person’s response during breathwork. It teaches practitioners to recognize potential trauma responses while prioritizing safety, consent, autonomy, and appropriate pacing without diagnosing, treating, or attempting to force emotional release.

steps.label: Week 5
steps.title: The Art of Facilitation
steps.text: Learn the art of holding space and intentionally curating a breathwork experience from beginning to end. Develop the presence, awareness, and confidence to create a safe and supportive environment while using music, energy, guidance, and intentional pacing to support the journey as it naturally unfolds.

steps.label: Week 6
steps.title: Growing Your Practice
steps.text: Business structuring, branding, and marketing strategies.

steps.label: Week 7
steps.title: Creating Your Offerings
steps.text: Designing workshops and 1:1 sessions using Canva, Eventbrite, AI tools, and CRM systems.

steps.label: Week 8
steps.title: Integration and Certification
steps.text: Final assessment, workshop launch, and certification ceremony.
